title: Clients
source: Read-only via Notion MCP notion-fetch on 2026-11-14; from a live CRM. Data source ids are not carried and are NOT portable: a deploy creates new ones.

Name.description: Kept current by the agent from what the client says (never invented); the owner may edit.
Name.note: The person's real name, plus the company (Ahmed, Qimma Auctions). A Hub write replaces only an empty title, an address, a phone number or a chat id, never a real name (P140 P1b).

Email.description: Kept current by the agent from what the client says (never invented); the owner may edit.
Email.note: The Hub's link key: filled when empty, never cleared or replaced; a second address goes to Other emails (P140 P1b).

Phone.description: Kept current by the agent from what the client says (never invented); the owner may edit.

Telegram.note: Description: "Edited by people. Telegram username without @ (e.g. anna_k) or a phone in +E.164. The Hub links this person's Telegram chat to the client when it matches exactly one client." Read by the Hub's messenger autolink (P84).

WhatsApp.note: Description: "Edited by people. WhatsApp number in +E.164 (country code first), only when it differs from Phone. The Hub matches WhatsApp chats against Phone and this field." Read by the Hub's messenger autolink (P84).

Relationship.description: Kept current by the agent from what the client says (never invented); the owner may edit.

Type.description: Kept current by the agent from what the client says (never invented); the owner may edit.

Lead source.note: generic: Referral, Past client, Event, Outbound, Other
Lead source.description: Kept current by the agent from what the client says (never invented); the owner may edit.

Last sent at.note: Description: "Written by the Hub when a reply to this client is sent (its send button or Sent detection). Do not edit." With Last sent by: who of the team last wrote to the client (P89, decision 0043). Not Last outbound, which is the CRM sync's.

Last sent by.note: Description: "Written by the Hub: the name of the team member whose Hub sent the last reply (their setup name). Do not edit." Project setting notion.stamp_sends (on by default) switches the write (P89).

Next step.description: Kept current by the agent from what the client says (never invented); the owner may edit.
Next step.note: The Hub also writes it from the client map's nearest open step (`client_map`); the agent and the owner may edit it.

No task.formula: contact allowed, Relationship Lead/Prospect/Client, Activity Active/Quiet, no open task
